items.title: Schuller Gunther — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Anyway, she gave this – that’s right, you’ve got it – she gave this big party. I don’t know what the occasion was. I remember – there were 50 musicians... Suddenly I found myself lying on the floor. Charlie Parker comes over.

ctx.x: Baroness, yeah. What was her name? Rosencrantz or something?
